import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static long input(Scanner sc) {
        long t = 0;
        char ch = (char) sc.next().charAt(0);
        while (ch < 33) {
            ch = (char) sc.next().charAt(0);
        }
        while (ch > 33) {
            t = (t << 3) + (t << 1) + (ch - '0');
            ch = (char) sc.next().charAt(0);
        }
        return t;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long i, x, y, n, a, b, p, q, temp, t1, t2;
        a = 0;
        b = 1;
        x = input(sc);
        y = input(sc);
        n = input(sc);

        for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            p = x * i / y;
            q = p + 1;
            temp = (long) (i * Math.abs(x * b - a * y));
            t1 = (long) (b * Math.abs(x * i - y * p));
            t2 = (long) (b * Math.abs(x * i - y * q));
            if (t1 < temp) {
                a = p;
                b = i;
                temp = t1;
            }
            if (t2 < temp) {
                a = q;
                b = i;
                temp = t2;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(a + "/" + b);
        sc.close();
    }
}
